metadata.description: Claude Code plugins published by Zentrik.

plugins.name: zentrik
plugins.description: Bring your team's product decisions, customer evidence, and research Studies into Claude Code. Brief work before you build, set up a trustworthy product workspace, import evidence with bounded writes, or manage a Study from a learning need through human-reviewed draft findings. Claude reads and changes only the Zentrik workspace you choose during OAuth, within your Zentrik role and granted scopes.
